verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility: existing apps switch by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID. That generic path is how most coding agents and frameworks would connect. A community user also reports 'official support' for Cursor, and the provider is reachable via OpenRouter and partner APIs. However, the evidence includes no first-party guide naming a specific coding agent or agent framework, and one user hit a format error going through the third-party claude-code-router. missing for 10: documented first-party integration guides for named coding agents (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Cline) and agent frameworks, confirmation of the Cursor support from Cerebras docs, independent hands-on corroboration of smooth agent integration.
